card.name: Civil engineering and construction text
card.fires_on: Words in web text about civil or environmental engineering, construction and public works, such as 'include' after 'These specialties' or 'applying' in a definition of engineering. It also fires on a few unrelated words in professional bios and project descriptions.

modes.label: Engineering specialties lists
modes.description: Verbs and commas introducing or inside a list of engineering branches.
modes.example: These specialties<< include>> structural, hydraulic, environmental and geotechn

modes.label: Engineering definitions
modes.description: Verbs such as applying or applied in sentences defining what engineers do.
modes.example: Engineering is the art of<< applying>> scientific and mathematical principles, experience, judgment

modes.label: Project and professional bios
modes.description: Words in construction project costs or professional society and firm descriptions.
modes.example: FEMA’s share is 75 percent of the total $9,233,065<< estimated>> cost of the reconstruction project.

card.plain: It lights up on ordinary words in web pages about civil engineering and construction work.
